title: Harnessing digital technologies for poverty reduction. Evidence for low-income and lower-middle income countries

paper_level.technology_measure_main: Mobile subscriptions per 100 (MCS) and internet users % (IU), logged

notes: Outcome is poverty headcount (outcome family 4), not output or productivity. GDP per capita appears only as a control and as the instrument for ICT, never as the dependent variable, so no output or productivity estimate is reported.
